Overdrive, Thirty-Five Bodies

The 3×3×3 block of VEs with its eight interior voids — thirty-five bodies, sixty-four face welds — driven through the same 360°. Every body does what the ring's four did; at +60° all thirty-five fold onto one octahedron. The physical range is the 60° arc from −60° to 0°. Beyond it the bodies pass through each other and through their own centres, the spacing falls to zero and goes negative, and the plates turn inside out and back. Fronts are painted solid, backs pale and dashed. Joints are held by identity and checked on every frame.

Spacing per site against the fold

1.155·cos(a + 30°) — the model's law continued. The shaded arc is the physical range; zero at +60° and +240° is every centre on one point; negative is the array turned inside out. Dashed curve, right scale: the spread of the centres about their mean — zero only at the two collapses.
